patches.summary: Add an UPPER_SNAKE_CASE fallback tier to store.go LookupFieldValue so typed-column extraction resolves BSE's SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE response keys (SCRIP_CD, NEWS_DT, CRITICALNEWS, NEWSSUB).
patches.reason: Generator bug: LookupFieldValue only tried snake/camel/Pascal casing, so every typed/indexed column was written NULL for BSE's all-caps keys, silently breaking stale/critical/concall/outcomes which read typed columns. Fixed locally as an additive last-tier fallback; filed upstream to the Printing Press.

patches.summary: Replace the generic newSyncCmd with a holdings-aware sync (newBSESyncCmd) that iterates the holdings table and fetches announcements per scrip; BSE's announcements feed returns empty without a scrip code.
patches.reason: The generated generic sync calls the announcements endpoint with no scrip and gets an empty body. BSE keys filings on scrip_code, so sync must loop holdings. syncResource is retained for workflow archive of the non-announcement resources.

patches.summary: Exclude announcements from workflow archive's generic resource list (synced per-holding by sync instead) and route syncResource's NDJSON progress stream to stderr under --json so the summary object is valid JSON.
patches.reason: Generic syncResource errors with 'missing id for announcements' (per-scrip endpoint) and its os.Stdout NDJSON events interleaved with the final summary object, producing invalid --json output.

patches.summary: Validate that scrip-code positionals are numeric on quote / results-snapshot (generated promoted commands) and the hand-written concall / thesis-drift, returning exit 2 for non-numeric input; add a --dry-run request-shape preview to the two promoted commands.
patches.reason: BSE returns HTTP 200 with empty/placeholder data for invalid scrip codes, so a non-numeric arg produced a confusing empty response (exit 0) instead of an actionable usage error. Scrip codes are always numeric.

patches.summary: ReplaceConcallChunks performs the concall delete+insert inside a single transaction (Greptile P1), plus UNIQUE(filing_id, paragraph_n) on concall_chunks and UNIQUE(filing_id) on results_outcomes with INSERT OR REPLACE (Greptile P2).
patches.reason: Greptile findings on the publish PR: the original two-transaction delete-then-insert was silently destructive on a crash, and the tables lacked dedup constraints.

patches.summary: critical --days now excludes rows whose news_dt is unparseable (!ok || t.Before(cutoff)) instead of letting them leak through the window filter.
patches.reason: Greptile P1 on the publish PR: the original ok && t.Before(cutoff) condition meant any malformed/empty date bypassed the --days window.
